name: Apollo 12
intro: Whoopie! Pete Conrad here. That may have been a small step for Neil, but it's a long one for me!
Our mission: a PINPOINT landing right next to an old robot, Surveyor 3.
Oh, and our rocket got hit by lightning. Twice. During launch.
We're fine! Mostly. Let's land with the Sun low behind us.
briefing: The lightning scrambled our instruments for a while.
Choose the landing site: the Surveyor 3 crater or one of the backup sites.
fact: Apollo 12 landed within walking distance of Surveyor 3 and brought pieces of it home.

alarm.title: Lightning Strike
alarm.alarm: POWER GLITCH — ALL WARNING LIGHTS ON
alarm.briefing: Lightning knocked our power out for a moment and every warning light came on! Systems are back. Now choose where we land!
